_readme: expect.label is the label the turn SHOULD get. expect.label_any lists several
when the right answer is genuinely debatable — say so instead of picking one and
calling a defensible disagreement a failure. expect.mode is set only where the
mode is structurally guaranteed (every BROWSE delegates); elsewhere it is a UX
judgement and scoring it would just add noise.
'why' carries provenance. Cases marked INCIDENT are frozen from live failures
recorded in CLAUDE.md — those are the regression net.

cases.message: which teams qualified for fifa finals 2026
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-17: fell to plain chat, which answered 'ask me to search the web for it'. The gate blocked 7 of 8 questions this shape while the classifier labelled 8/8 WEB.

cases.message: whihc teams have qualified for fifa finals 2026
cases.known_gap: The gate misses this and that is ACCEPTED: fuzzy-matching question words was measured and rejected (rapidfuzz scores 'here'->'where' 89, ABOVE 'whihc'->'which' 80 — no threshold separates a typo from an ordinary opening word). rescue_web_turn catches it instead. Kept red-but-known so a fix, or a regression in the backstop, is visible.
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-17: the typo'd retry missed the gate too.

cases.message: tell me when is the new season of black clover coming out
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-17: the clause that actually broke — the old shape rule allowed ONE filler word before the question word, and 'tell me when' is two.

cases.message: tell me when is the new season of black clover coming out, and who is the prime minister of pakistan and whihc teams have qualified for fifa finals 2026
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-17, verbatim from the DB. Survived only on 'who is the prime minister'.

cases.message: tell me who won the match last night
cases.why: 2026-07-17 measured set: gate blocked, classifier said WEB.

cases.message: let me know when the next iphone is out
cases.why: 2026-07-17 measured set. Also a trap for the reminder router — 'let me know when' must not become a reminder.

cases.message: find out which teams qualified for the world cup
cases.why: 2026-07-17 measured set.

cases.message: i want to know the current gold price
cases.why: 2026-07-17: the subtle one — the 'i' belongs to the request frame, not the subject. Stripping the frame before the self-reference test is what separates it from 'why is my script slow'.

cases.message: is bitcoin up today
cases.why: 2026-07-17 measured set.

cases.message: what is the population of karachi
cases.why: 2026-07-17 measured set.

cases.message: who is the president of pakistan
cases.why: The control question used throughout the fan-out rounds: must stay a single-reading WEB lookup.

cases.message: search the web for the latest langgraph release
cases.why: Explicit web verb + noun.

cases.message: look this up online
cases.why: Web noun with no object of its own.

cases.message: find a good pizza recipe on the internet
cases.why: Web noun.

cases.message: open https://example.com and summarize it
cases.why: Reading a named page is WEB, not BROWSE — it does not ACT on the site.

cases.message: open junaidjamshed.com
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-08-01: answered by plain chat with 'It's with the browser agent in the background' while nothing ran. MEASURED: the classifier returned CHAT/BROWSE/CHAT on three runs of this exact message, which is why _is_bare_navigation now decides it in code with zero LLM calls.

cases.message: open youtube
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-08-01: searched YouTube for 'youtube' and played a video. Must route BROWSE and, at the loop layer, terminate on arrival.

cases.message: play jane by the long faces on youtube
cases.why: The original Phase 14 acceptance goal. BROWSE is ALWAYS delegated — run INLINE it holds the chat SSE open for the whole browse (live bug 2026-07-24).

cases.message: search and play some lofi on youtube
cases.why: Named media site + play verb.

cases.message: open youtube and play the new severance trailer
cases.why: Navigation + an action on the site.

cases.message: play despacito on spotify
cases.why: Named streaming site.

cases.message: add janan sports 100ml to cart on junaidjamshed.com
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-08-01/08-02: the commit flow. Acting on a live site, so BROWSE — and every submit still faces the approval gate.

cases.message: go to weworkremotely.com, find the three most recent senior python backend roles and apply to each
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-19: the multi-commit flow that produced RULE 22 (one browse_commit, not a browse plus one commit per item).

cases.message: delete old.log
cases.why: Baseline destructive file task.

cases.message: create a file called notes.txt on my desktop
cases.why: Baseline write task.

cases.message: run npm install in the frontend folder
cases.why: Terminal task.

cases.message: move report.pdf into Documents
cases.why: Baseline move.

cases.message: list the files in my downloads folder
cases.why: Baseline read task.

cases.message: please del all files with '.txt' extension from this folder
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-09: 'del' missed the old verb+domain gate, the message fell to plain chat, and the chat LLM fabricated an entire background-task lifecycle for a deletion that never ran. The reason the gate became recall-first.

cases.message: please yeet all files with '.txt' extension from this folder
cases.why: Users invent verbs endlessly — the OBJECT noun fires the gate alone and the classifier judges the wording.

cases.message: wipe out everything in my temp folder
cases.why: Unenumerable verb, strong noun.

cases.message: create a folder 'pdfs' on desktop and move all the pdf files that are in the downloads in that folder
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-29: the 85-PDF bulk move that reported 'Done — 2 step(s) completed' having moved zero files.

cases.message: tell me how many files are in phase3test folder
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-09: a real list_directory task phrased as a question.

cases.message: what did you do today
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-14: answered from the audit log by recall_actions, NOT from memory. The chat LLM asserted a wrong folder name and denied the real one. The own-action tier must stay ahead of the question tier.

cases.message: what was the name of the folder that u created?
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-14, verbatim. Only reached the classifier because it happened to say 'folder'.

cases.message: find the pdf about cloud computing on my machine
cases.why: Content search — semantic_file_search, not the web. FOUND AS A GAP BY THIS BENCH 2026-08-03 and FIXED the same day: the gate knew the words for CONTAINERS (file, folder, directory) and none of the words for the things kept inside them, so 'find the FILE about X' fired while 'find the PDF about X' was CLOSED and the whole file index was unreachable from chat. _DOCUMENT_NOUN_RE now carries the document vocabulary at the WEAK tier — measured: as STRONG nouns they fired on 'my resume is finally done' and 'that presentation was painful', and requiring an action verb drops those at zero recall cost.

cases.message: find the document about cloud computing
cases.why: The semantic-file-search gate hole, second instance — kept beside the first so the fix is proved GENERAL rather than fitted to the word 'pdf'.

cases.message: find my notes about cloud computing
cases.why: The semantic-file-search gate hole, third instance. 'notes' is the riskiest of the three — it is common in autobiography — which is why the document vocabulary sits at the WEAK tier and needs a verb.

cases.message: what did we discuss about cloud computing
cases.why: Phase 6 Part 4 conversation search — planner rule 17's own example phrasing. FOUND AS A GAP BY THIS BENCH 2026-08-03 and FIXED the same day by a `stored_recall` tier: is_external_question correctly refuses this (its subject is 'we' — it is not an external-FACT question) and no other tier had a word for a past conversation. The tier needs a request signal alongside the recall phrase, so 'we discussed this already' stays free, and it stands down entirely when the message addresses Jarvis's MEMORY ('do you remember what i told you about jamil') — the chat path already has that bundle injected.

cases.message: search my files for the cloud computing report
cases.why: CONTROL for the gate hole above: with the literal word 'files' the same intent fires strong_domain. Keeping the working phrasing beside the broken ones is what makes the hole legible.

cases.message: email jamil about the dinner tonight
cases.why: Phase 5 Part 3. The recipient lock applies whatever the label.

cases.message: any new emails in my inbox?
cases.why: A criterion-less inbox read.

cases.message: check my gmail
cases.why: Bare email noun.

cases.message: now send a new mail to that same address
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-12: 'mail' missed the gate, fell to plain chat, and the chat LLM imitated a real approval message.

cases.message: forward that email to my manager
cases.why: Forwarding is deliberately NOT a reply — it must go through send_email and face the grounding guard.

cases.message: put a meeting with jamil on my calendar tomorrow at 3
cases.why: Phase 5 Part 4. Must not be swallowed by the reminder router — no 'reminder'/'alarm' word.

cases.message: what's on my calendar this week
cases.why: Baseline calendar read.

cases.message: delete the standup event
cases.why: The event-id lock flow: find_events then delete_event via a PENDING placeholder.

cases.message: send jamil an invite for friday
cases.why: GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS and recorded as such: calendar tools never set attendees (sendUpdates='none'), so inviting a person is send_email territory — but the user said 'invite'. Both readings are defensible; scoring one as wrong would be scoring a disagreement.

cases.message: how are you today
cases.why: The control that must stay free — no gate fire, no classifier call, no plan.

cases.message: jamil and i played tekken yesterday
cases.why: A shared-fact statement for the memory engine, not a task.

cases.message: my sister is a doctor in lahore
cases.why: Autobiography.

cases.message: what's my brother's name?
cases.why: A question about the USER — answered from memory; the web cannot help. This exclusion is what makes the wide question tier affordable.

cases.message: my brother deleted my save file yesterday
cases.why: GATE FALSE POSITIVE BY DESIGN: strong noun, no request. The classifier exists to catch exactly this — it is a report, not an instruction.

cases.message: i finally organized my desktop
cases.why: GATE FALSE POSITIVE BY DESIGN. Past tense about the user's own action.

cases.message: i sent him the files yesterday
cases.why: GATE FALSE POSITIVE BY DESIGN, cited in CLAUDE.md as the accepted cost of the recall-first rule: one tiny temp-0 call that answers CHAT.

cases.message: what is a monad
cases.why: The accepted cost of the wider question tier, stated out loud in the 2026-07-17 round: an impersonal concept question reaches the classifier and answers CHAT.

cases.message: tell me a joke
cases.why: Request frame, no external fact.

cases.message: who are you?
cases.why: Self-referential — the web cannot answer it.

cases.message: do you remember what i told you about jamil
cases.why: Memory recall through the chat path's MEMORY CONTEXT.

cases.message: i love this song
cases.why: A bare media mention with no action verb must not fire the weak path.

cases.message: thanks, that worked
cases.why: A comment on a FINISHED action is CHAT — the counterpart to the follow-up rule below, and the pair the classifier prompt has to separate.

cases.message: yes
cases.why: With no open plan this is conversation. (With one, it never reaches routing — the plan owns the turn.)

cases.message: send it

conversation.content: draft an email to jamil saying i'll be late
I've drafted it: To jamil@example.com, Subject: Running late. Body: Sorry — I'll be about twenty minutes behind.

cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-13: names no object of its own, so the gate could never fire on its words — the chat LLM fabricated 'I've started working on that in the background'. is_action_followup borrows the object from the conversation.

cases.message: its present in desktop

conversation.content: delete everything in the phase3test folder
I couldn't find a folder called phase3test. Where is it?

cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-10: in isolation the classifier called this 'an answer to an earlier question' and routed CHAT, and the chat LLM answered with promises it cannot keep. It must be judged IN its conversation.

cases.message: message him 'hi'
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-21: names no site and no strong noun, so only the LIVE WINDOW can carry it to the classifier. browse_window simulates an open agent tab, which is what is_browse_followup reads.

cases.message: delete all the tmp files in my downloads and tell me when you're done
cases.why: INCIDENT 2026-07-09: the intent phrase must be STRIPPED before classification — with it attached the classifier read the whole message as a reminder request, listed it CHAT, and Jarvis denied having file access.
